nodes.title: The Notebook's 'Then and now' page lists each skill that became pakka at a known time (the map's secureSince, 046), newest first, at most 12. Each entry shows 'First met on {date}' with the first Notebook lesson on its topic before then ('with a hint' when that lesson's card says so; never 'wrong'), that lesson's first board (replayable), 'Pakka since {date}', and the made-for pieces on the topic built before it was pakka ('This helped'). No counts, scores or streaks; no new server work. Also fixes the Notebook's board frame (the Studio stage filled the whole page entry). Reverse: Learning ships a per-skill first-try record, which then replaces the first-lesson proxy.

md.decisions:
## `dc-r7-app-growth-page`
A child who struggled can see it: the board from the day they first met fractions, and the day it became pakka, side by side. It is the reason to open the Notebook between lessons.
